executiveSummary: GM0312 passes the complete deterministic contract over all ten canonical scenarios, T+0/6/12/24/48/72 and all eight essential services. Its 2025 CBS identity, generalized boundary, 16,279 residents, eight neighbourhoods, three BAG places, four BRT settlements, Bunnik station, 19 transit stop areas and public water/facility context are coherent; official nulls, zero-intensity behavior, local reconciliation, causal ledgers, cumulative event-attributable essential-service person-hours and map-layer invariance also pass. Release remains correction-required for three reproducible defects. First, the transport generator treats the E30 co-designation at Knooppunt Rijnsweerd as an independent 150-capacity Bunnik-Utrecht edge alongside A27 even though live official NWB records carry routeltr E/routenr 30 with wegnummer 027; deleting only that generated edge changes compound T+24 telecom availability by -0.067143, demonstrating material solver sensitivity but not licensing blind removal. Second, river, pluvial and heat maps rank all eight neighbourhoods identically because one hazard-independent hash drives local allocation, while official Utrecht water, heat and drought surfaces differ and frequently return NoData. Third, an ignition placed inside official TOP10NL deciduous forest in Buitengebied Werkhoven leaves that source neighbourhood last. The canonical river result also retains an internal depth-like proxy of 1.422296 through T+72 without a selected Lek/Kromme Rijn hydraulic event; Bunnik has genuine flood pathways, so the conservative state is Unknown rather than zero or safe. Public provider, water-object, station, stop, antenna, school and facility records remain context only. Complete physical utility topology, operating state, backup, stock, crews and restoration commitments are unavailable or security-sensitive and were not invented; all service transfers correctly remain labeled logical proxies.

evidenceSources.title: Gemeente and buurt gegeneraliseerd 2025 with BAG, BRT TOP10NL, NWB and railway context

supports: Official annual CC BY 4.0 GM0312 municipality and eight-neighbourhood geometry consumed by the application; the generated reference point and the Bunnik, Odijk and Werkhoven BAG place centres are inside the generalized polygon.

BAG place access is https://api.pdok.nl/kadaster/bag/ogc/v2/collections/woonplaats. BRT/TOP10NL access is https://api.pdok.nl/kadaster/brt-top10nl/ogc/v1 and contributes four topographic settlements plus national 1:10,000 editioned topography under CC BY 4.0. Deciduous-forest objects 106214199 at [5.164840585970715, 52.07507181474737] and 106205688 at [5.24986531144451, 52.03430213300161] support focused synthetic diagnostics in Buitengebied Bunnik Noord and Buitengebied Werkhoven; static land cover is not live fuel, spread or an incident perimeter.

NWB WFS https://service.pdok.nl/rws/nationaal-wegenbestand-wegen/wfs/v1_0?service=WFS&version=2.0.0&request=GetCapabilities is national monthly CC0 road geometry. Live Knooppunt Rijnsweerd records wvk 278309019 and 278309026 both carry routeltr E/routenr 30, but their wegnummer values are respectively 027 and 028. E30 is therefore a co-designation spanning physical A27 and A28 sections at the interchange, not one independent Dutch road identity. ProRail OGC https://api.pdok.nl/prorail/spoorwegen/ogc/v1/collections/station identifies Bunnik station but not live rail operation or capacity.

evidenceSources.title: Regionaal Risicoprofiel Utrecht 2023
supports: The adopted strategic profile treats river flooding as potentially catastrophic and identifies the northern Lekdijk multi-breach case as a regional worst case; this supports a genuine pathway near Bunnik but not the simulator's depth, arrival, footprint or duration.

It covers extreme rain, drought/nature fire, heat, heavy storm, snow/ice, earthquake and cyber/vital-infrastructure failure, including utility disruption outside directly wet areas and long-duration response-capacity pressure.

The profile is qualitative regional scenario context, not a live warning, local incident footprint, recurrence probability, asset inventory or restoration commitment. It also says there is no reliable method for converting neighbourhood self-reliance differences into exact response capacity, so demographic aggregates must remain contextual.

evidenceSources.title: Milieu-effectscreening Omgevingsvisie Bunnik 2040
supports: The municipality states that the sewer was designed for a roughly once-in-two-years event up to 20 mm/h; few reports do not prove adequacy, Werkhoven has critical perched-groundwater conditions, and a 60 mm/h climate event is used for stress context.

It distinguishes the Kromme Rijn/Amsterdam-Rijnkanaal catchment, local storage and Nieuw Wulven storage, and identifies local hotspots including Zeisterweg and Langstraat for the 2024–2028 programme. These are mechanism/location context, not live drainage state or a calibrated citywide 72-hour flood trajectory.

The report identifies heat and warm-night stress in the Bunnik, Odijk and Werkhoven cores. Its public PDF offers no machine API, fixed update cadence or explicit blanket redistribution licence; the official municipal page must remain cited with edition and retrieval time.

evidenceSources.title: Bunnik water-system context, pumping station Odijk, RWZI Bunnik and national IMWA/DAMO registers
evidenceSources.edition: Current HDSR pages and national register snapshot inspected 2 September 2026
supports: HDSR explains that pumping station Odijk on the N229 supports drainage during heavy rainfall and water supply during dry periods. Machine access is available through HWH Kunstwerken IMWA https://api.pdok.nl/hwh/waterschappen-kunstwerken-imwa/ogc/v2 and Waterketen DAMO https://api.pdok.nl/hwh/waterschappen-waterketen-damo/ogc/v1 under CC BY-SA 4.0. Kunstwerken is published weekly; DAMO contributor completeness and cadence vary and must travel with each snapshot.

The current boundary query yields 52 display-only water objects: two sewer pumps, RWZI Bunnik, 11 surface-water pumps, one sluice and 37 weirs. Presence does not establish hydraulic/sewer connectivity, capacity, setpoint, operating state, emergency power or first-72-hour restoration.

At the eight CBS neighbourhood reference points, the HDSR 75 mm layer returns 0.18 m in Buitengebied Odijk and 0.01 m in Buitengebied Bunnik Zuid and Buitengebied Werkhoven, while five points return NoData. evidenceSources.title: Landelijk Informatiesysteem Water en Overstromingen (LIWO)
supports: LIWO is the official national flood-information system intended for preparation, exercises and crisis management and contains consequence information for named scenarios.

The publisher explicitly requires specialist interpretation. A local integration must pin the selected scenario, connected water pathway, defence/breach/control assumptions, depth, arrival, duration/recession, units, resolution, NoData and edition rather than deriving impact from municipality-centre distance.

No blanket open-data licence or guaranteed update cadence was established from the inspected landing page. Until an approved extract is available, unavailable local hydraulic-event coverage is Unknown and must not become zero, safe or a synthetic precision claim.

findings.summary: The generated Bunnik-Utrecht E30 logical edge blends physical A27 and A28 corridor sections under one route-label proxy and materially changes the eight-service solver.
findings.evidence: E02's live official NWB WFS records wvk 278309019 and 278309026 at Knooppunt Rijnsweerd carry routeltr E/routenr 30 but respectively wegnummer 027 and 028. A27 records wvk 600128588/600128864 use wegnummer 027; nationally signed A28 records establish 028 as the separate A28 corridor. The generated transport file nevertheless contains independent links nwb-link-353 A27, 1.129 km/capacity 260 and nwb-link-436 E30, 0.363 km/capacity 150, both GM0312-GM0344, with the E30 edge collapsing source sections from both physical road numbers. scripts/fetch-realism-data.mjs:402-404,488-491,535-569 derives and deduplicates by route label before physical NWB corridor identity. At compound T+24 the E30 proxy has nonzero normalized flow for power 0.343766, water 0.098907, drainage 0.275292, telecom 0.728530, mobility 0.626967, facilities 0.288219 and supply 0.653343. Removing only that edge changes pressure 0.615179116 to 0.625228077, affected population 10,899 to 11,129, water availability 0.463555182 to 0.453127791 and telecom 0.687549056 to 0.620405729. This is a sensitivity diagnostic, not evidence that either physical corridor should be deleted.
findings.action: Before release, rebuild corridor identity from NWB wvk/wegnummer, shared/coincident geometry, direction and endpoint evidence; coalesce route co-designations and parallel carriageways into one inspectable logical physical-corridor group while retaining every source wvkId and route label. Add GM0312 A27/E30 regression and national duplicate checks. Do not remove all E-routes blindly, infer utility topology, or treat nominal capacity as vehicles/megawatts/litres.

findings.summary: One hazard-independent neighbourhood hash makes Bunnik river, pluvial and heat maps exactly rank-identical despite distinct official climate surfaces.
findings.evidence: packages/sim-core/src/model.ts:3567-3580 uses one hazardSeed based on city seed, scenario seed and region id. River, pluvial and heat all rank Buitengebied Bunnik Noord, Buitengebied Bunnik Zuid, Odijk, Buitengebied Odijk, Bunnik, Werkhoven, Vechten and Buitengebied Werkhoven in exactly that order. E06 instead exposes distinct HDSR 75 mm/1 h water, UHI, warm-night and drought rasters: diagnostic reference points include water 0.18 m in Buitengebied Odijk, UHI 1.065 in Bunnik, and high drought with UHI 0 in Buitengebied Bunnik Noord, with NoData at five of eight water points. Point samples are not zonal means or observations, but establish that the simulator order is not source-derived.
findings.action: Until event-specific geometry is integrated, mark neighbourhood impact ranks unsupported and prohibit operational prioritization from them. Pin source layer/version/event/reference date/units/resolution/licence, compute polygon-aware zonal values, preserve NoData as Unknown, and type modeled climate context separately from synthetic T+0–72 output.

findings.summary: An explicit ignition inside official deciduous forest in Buitengebied Werkhoven does not control the displayed local wildfire impact.
findings.evidence: E02 identifies TOP10NL forest object 106205688 and focused source [5.24986531144451, 52.03430213300161] inside BU03120209 Buitengebied Werkhoven. A focused synthetic T+24 run reports direct fire 0.583712, smoke 0.529699, drought 0.609758 and city severity 0.576035, yet the source neighbourhood ranks eighth at 0.516364 while Buitengebied Bunnik Noord ranks first at 0.675324. Static forest cover and this diagnostic are neither an observed incident nor a forecast, but they falsify source-aware local allocation.
findings.action: Keep direct-fire neighbourhood ranks visibly synthetic/unsupported and prohibit operational rank use. Make local allocation source/perimeter and eligible-fuel aware using versioned TOP10NL as an open static fallback, while modeling transported smoke, drought, wind, access, extinguishing water and suppression assumptions separately.

findings.summary: A coarse Rhine/Meuse/IJssel proximity field produces persistent Bunnik inundation stress without a selected local Lek/Kromme Rijn hydraulic event.
findings.evidence: packages/sim-core/src/model.ts:430-470 uses municipality-reference-point distance to approximate named-major-river segments. At T+24 and T+72 the canonical river preset reports internal depth-like proxy 1.422296, approximately 94.82% normalized UI inundation stress, severity 0.440119 and zero recovery for all services; affected population is 4,914 then 5,750 and cumulative event-attributable person-hours 142,792 then 581,398. E03 supports genuine northern-Lekdijk regional catastrophe potential, and E04-E05 support Kromme Rijn/local drainage pathways, but no selected connected event, defence/control state, depth, arrival, duration or recession surface supports the displayed Bunnik-wide amplitude. This is municipality-specific evidence of a shared screening defect, not a claim that Bunnik is flood-safe.
findings.action: Conservatively render direct GM0312 river impact Unknown/numerically neutral until an expert selects a named, connected and versioned LIWO/HDSR event. Keep Lek-defence, Kromme Rijn, local drainage/pluvial and indirect access/supply pathways separately visible and unresolved; never convert unavailable event coverage to zero or safety.

findings.summary: Fifty-two public water objects improve Bunnik context but do not establish drainage/wastewater connectivity, capacity, control state or restoration.
findings.evidence: E05 contributes two sewer pumps, RWZI Bunnik, 11 surface-water pumps, one sluice and 37 weirs, including Odijk drainage/supply and the RWZI catchment/discharge description. The application correctly marks all 52 objects affectsSimulation=false. findings.summary: Storm, heat/drought, winter, cyber, earthquake and remote coastal/wildfire effects are bounded exercises but not calibrated Bunnik forecasts or probabilities.

residualLimitations: This is a deterministic planning-model audit, not validation against an observed Bunnik disaster, outage, casualty, evacuation, welfare or restoration dataset.
The 2025 generalized CBS boundary is appropriate for municipal aggregation but not parcel-level hydraulics, asset ownership, response jurisdiction or exact incident geometry.

Province Utrecht water/heat/drought layers are modeled context surfaces; reference-point identify is not zonal analysis, NoData is common, and catalogue update dates do not prove physical refresh cadence.

Official Lek, Kromme Rijn, sewer, watercourse and asset context does not prove hydraulic connection, defence failure, depth, arrival, duration or recession; an expert must select and version a physically relevant event.
TOP10NL forest cover is static context rather than live fuel, moisture, spread, suppression or access state; the focused Werkhoven ignition is synthetic.
HWH/provider/antenna/facility/station/GTFS records are partial dated context, not complete topology, capacity, operating state, backup, stock or restoration commitments.
No reviewed public safe source provides complete Stedin, Vitens, municipal sewer, gas, telecom, care, food/fuel or emergency-resource topology/state; sensitive detail was not inferred.

First-72-hour household behavior, medically dependent people, responders, mutual aid, shelters, pharmacies, fuel/food stocks, crew travel, repair priorities and visitor/daytime demand remain scenario assumptions or Unknown.
